|notes=The Players Committee released Set 7 on 16 July 2004. [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946id_/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Release announcement]. The July sheet prints an extra “The” in Agents Of Black Sun. October restores the existing title, so both 2004 slips share the same operative state. The remaster replaces the two named Objective sides with an expansion-marked Objective you own, and expressly names your deploy phase for the single non-weapon pull. The Imperial City, Scum And Villainy and Black Sun conditions remain. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/swccgglossarysupplement.pdf Decipher’s objective title and faces]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 Period One Rule]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=92 Period expansion icons].

* [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205104319/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%207.pdf Virtual Set #7 updated sheet] (12 October 2004; Internet Archive 5 December 2004), page 2, slip 17.
